name: appdyno
stderr:
usage: appdyno <command> [flags]; appdyno <command> --help for its flags

commands:
  mcp [--device S] [--app A] [--allow-devices RE] [--allow-apps a,b] [--allow-urls RE] [--allow-data-loss virtual|all] [--allow-power virtual|all] [--no-home] [--silent] [--takeover] [--share] [--animations on|off] [--measurements dir] [--trace-limit-gb N] [--flight-seconds N] [--full-urls] [--no-install-consent] [--accept-install-warnings] [--http 127.0.0.1:PORT]
                   the MCP server over stdio; with --http, on this Mac's loopback behind a token
  install [--yes] [--dry-run] [--remove]
                   add this server to the MCP clients on this Mac, or take it out
  update [--check] move to the latest release, verified before anything changes; --check changes nothing
  path [--remove]  from the app: put this appdyno on the PATH of every shell, or take it off
  devices          the connected devices
  version          which version this is
  test <dir or files> [--device S]... [--param NAME=value]... [--env-file F] [--tag T]... [--exclude-tag T]... [--artifacts dir] [--junit file] [--share] [--retries N] [--measure [--iterations N] [--measurements dir]]
                   replay flows, one after another, on each device; --retries runs a failed file again and calls it flaky; --measure keeps each as a scenario, by step
  doctor [--serial S]
                   what this machine and that device lack
  ios build        build the iOS runners now
  push setup apns|fcm [--forget]
                   a push service's credentials, which a person gives here and push uses; --forget deletes them
  tools install [adb] [--accept-license]
                   download the trace tools; adb: Google's platform-tools, under Google's terms
  bench --serial S [--n 50] [--out file] [--max-load N]
                   time reads, taps and typing on an Android device
  mirror [open] [--device S]... [--all [--watch]] [--max N] [--detach] [--quality auto|high|standard] [--codec h264|hevc] [--wifi] [--no-input] [--headless] [--pair] [--seconds N] [--takeover] [--record file.mp4] [--focus] [--allow-devices RE]
                   a live window on a device, driven by mouse and keyboard
  mirror close|status|stats
  pair [address code] [--device S] [--forget]
                   this Mac with a phone for Wi-Fi, once: an iPhone on its cable by --device, an Android phone by what it shows
  hub [--focus] [--allow-devices RE]
                   every device of this Mac in one window: start, stop, make one, open its window
  perf compare|baseline|budget [--app A] [--scenario S] [--device-class C] [--last N] [--replace] [--format text|json|junit] [--measurements dir]
                   the performance gate: non-zero on a regression or a broken budget
  perf why|reference [--app A] [--scenario S] [--device-class C] [--device S] [--dsym path] [--format text|json|junit] [--measurements dir] [--share]
                   the gate, and on a regression its cause, found on the device; reference: what that diffs against, on the baseline's build
  perf comment --out file [--app A] [--scenario S] [--device-class C] [--measurements dir]
                   the gate's newest answers as Markdown in a file, for your own CI to post; no device
  perf functions --from pm-a --to pm-b [--measurements dir]
                   which functions moved between two kept profiles
  perf prune [--limit-gb N] [--dry-run] [--measurements dir]
                   kept traces and heap dumps down to the limit, 10 GB by default
  timeline --app A [--device S] [--flow file] [--seconds N] [--dir dir] [--full-urls]
                   video, touches, frames, requests, log and memory on one clock, in one file: for a flow, or for N seconds of your hands
  flight --app A [--device S] [--seconds N] [--dir dir] [--full-urls]
                   keeps the last N seconds of an app as a timeline, saved on a crash or a stall, until Ctrl-C
  perf dashboard [--app A] [--out dir] [--open] [--measurements dir]
                   one page: what can be read on each device, what changed, what needs attention
  perf survey --
